fact: South Sudan's Ministry of ICT and Postal Services announced on 22 November 2024 an aerial survey and base mapping of Juba City and County, to be done in 2025, to produce maps for establishing a Geographic Addressing System, with Juba selected as the pilot area.
Juba City Legislative Council speaker says the council has named six main streets and put up signposts, with a committee to name the rest, to help fire and police rescue.
